# SYNESIS_E144 — Error

## Description

extraction collides with example (same environment variable).

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
`extraction` collides with `example`: both names become the same
  coder environment variable (SYNESIS_CODER_PHASE_<NAME>_*). Rename one of the phases.
```
